Low GI and nutrient-dense, Quaker Oats are the ultimate no-nonsense clean carbohydrate source.

nutrition.ingredients: 100% Whole Grain Rolled Oats
nutrition.usage: Stovetop: bring 1 cup water to boil, add 1/2 cup oats, cook 5 minutes. Microwave: combine 1/2 cup oats and 1 cup water, microwave 2–3 minutes. Serve with milk, banana, nuts, or protein powder.
benefits: Beta-glucan soluble fibre reduces LDL cholesterol
Low GI for stable blood sugar
Whole grain source of B-vitamins and minerals
100% natural — no additives
Versatile base for many fitness meals
nutrition.warnings: Contains gluten (oats). Not suitable for coeliac disease or severe gluten intolerance. Store in a cool, dry place.

fields.name: MuscleBlaze High Protein Granola – Cranberry & Almond
fields.description: MuscleBlaze High Protein Granola combines golden-baked rolled oats with whey protein, dried cranberries, and whole almonds to create a nutritionally superior breakfast cereal. Each serving provides 15g of protein — 2x the protein of standard granola. Low in added sugar and made with cold-pressed virgin coconut oil, it's a wholesome meal or snack that supports both performance and recovery.

nutrition.ingredients: Rolled Oats (50%), Whey Protein Concentrate (18%), Almonds (8%), Dried Cranberries (8%), Coconut Oil, Honey, Sunflower Seeds, Cinnamon
nutrition.usage: Mix with milk or yogurt for a protein-rich breakfast. Eat dry as a snack. Use as a topping for smoothie bowls.
benefits: 15g protein per serving — 2x standard granola
Made with cold-pressed virgin coconut oil
Real whole almonds and dried cranberries
Source of fibre and complex carbohydrates
No artificial colours or flavours
nutrition.warnings: Contains milk, oats (gluten), almonds, and sulphites (dried cranberries). Not for coeliac disease or nut allergy sufferers.

fields.name: HealthKart Premium California Almonds – Raw
fields.description: HealthKart Premium California Almonds are premium-grade raw almonds imported directly from California's Central Valley — the world's leading almond-producing region. Rich in Vitamin E, magnesium, healthy monounsaturated fats, and protein, almonds are the perfect all-day snack for fitness enthusiasts. Unsalted, unroasted, and free from additives, delivering the purest natural nutrition in every handful.

nutrition.ingredients: 100% Raw California Almonds
nutrition.usage: Eat as a healthy snack. Soak overnight for improved digestion and bioavailability. Add to breakfast bowls, salads, or smoothies.
benefits: 6g protein per serving
Highest food source of Vitamin E per ounce
Rich in magnesium for muscle function
Heart-healthy monounsaturated fats
Prebiotic fibre for gut health
nutrition.warnings: Contains tree nuts (almonds). May contain traces of other tree nuts and peanuts. Store in a cool, dry place.

fields.name: Gymshark Lifting Club Stringer Tank – Black
fields.description: The Gymshark Lifting Club Stringer is built for bodybuilding and strength training. Cut with deep armhole openings for maximum range of motion and ventilation during heavy lifts, and featuring Gymshark's signature sweat-wicking fabric, it moves with your body rather than against it. A gym staple in a clean, classic black colourway that works with any shorts or jogger.

clothing.care_instructions: Machine wash cold with similar colours. Do not tumble dry. Do not iron. Do not bleach. Do not dry clean.

fields.name: Nike Dri-FIT Training T-Shirt – Obsidian Blue
fields.description: The Nike Dri-FIT Training T-Shirt is the quintessential workout top. Built with Nike's industry-leading Dri-FIT technology, it pulls sweat away from your skin and accelerates evaporation to keep you dry and comfortable during the most intense sessions. A relaxed, standard fit allows full range of motion, while the rib collar maintains shape through repeated washes. Available in multiple colourways.

clothing.care_instructions: Machine wash cold. Tumble dry low. Do not iron directly on design. Do not dry clean.

fields.name: Gymshark Vital Seamless 2.0 Leggings – Black Marl
fields.description: The Gymshark Vital Seamless 2.0 Leggings are the gym girl's ultimate all-rounder. Designed for lifting, HIIT, running, and Pilates, these high-waisted leggings are made from a supportive, breathable seamless fabric that moulds to your body. The stay-put waistband never rolls down, and sweat-wicking technology keeps you cool and dry throughout any workout. Over 3,400 verified 5-star reviews from real customers. True to size.

clothing.care_instructions: Machine wash cold with same or similar colours. Do not dry clean, iron, use fabric softeners, or bleach. 25" inseam based on size M.

fields.name: Under Armour Launch Run 7" Shorts – Royal Blue
fields.description: Under Armour Launch Run 7-Inch Shorts are engineered for runners and cross-trainers who demand speed and comfort. The ultra-lightweight, 4-way stretch fabric moves with you in every direction, while UA Storm water-repellent technology protects in light rain. Internal briefs provide support without bunching, and the 7-inch inseam is the ideal length for unrestricted running stride. Elastic waistband with drawcord for an adjustable, secure fit.

clothing.material: 100% Polyester woven with UA Storm DWR finish
clothing.care_instructions: Machine wash cold. Do not use fabric softener. Tumble dry low. Do not iron.

fields.name: Nike Indy Light-Support Padded Sports Bra – Pink Spell
fields.description: The Nike Indy Light-Support Padded Sports Bra is engineered for low-to-medium impact training — yoga, Pilates, light weights, and stretching. Removable padding allows customised support, and the racerback design keeps straps out of your way during overhead movements. Made with at least 75% recycled materials and featuring Dri-FIT technology for sweat management. A wardrobe essential for active women.

clothing.material: 75% Recycled Polyester, 25% Spandex with Dri-FIT Technology
clothing.care_instructions: Machine wash cold. Tumble dry low. Do not iron on graphic. Remove pads before washing.

fields.name: Adidas Tiro 21 Training Pants – Black
fields.description: The Adidas Tiro 21 Training Pants are an iconic training essential worn by professional football players and gym-goers around the world. The tapered cut creates a clean, athletic silhouette while the stretchy, sweat-absorbent fabric delivers freedom of movement. Zip pockets secure essentials, and the dual ankle zip enables easy removal over boots or trainers. A performance product as comfortable for warmups as for commuting.

clothing.care_instructions: Machine wash at 40°C. Do not bleach. Tumble dry on low. Do not iron on graphic. Do not dry clean.

fields.name: Under Armour HeatGear Compression T-Shirt – White
fields.description: Under Armour HeatGear Compression T-Shirt is a second-skin performance layer worn under kit or alone. The ultra-lightweight, breathable fabric with anti-odor technology wicks sweat away and dries fast in warm weather. The fitted, compression cut supports muscles during intense training and reduces drag. Flatlock seams minimise chafing, and the 4-way stretch construction moves with your body in all directions.

clothing.care_instructions: Machine wash cold. Do not use fabric softener or dryer sheets. Tumble dry low. Do not iron. Do not bleach.

fields.name: Gymshark Adapt Animal Seamless Sports Bra – Forest Green
fields.description: The Gymshark Adapt Animal Seamless Sports Bra is a bold, high-impact design inspired by natural textures and movement. Built for medium-support activities including weights, gym sessions, and HIIT, it features a flattering scoop back, removable padding for personalised support, and Gymshark's seamless construction for all-day comfort. The eye-catching Animal print pattern is a Gymshark community favourite.

clothing.care_instructions: Machine wash cold with similar colours. Do not bleach, tumble dry, or iron. Remove padding before washing.

fields.name: Gymshark Vital Seamless Tank Top – Sage Green
fields.description: The Gymshark Vital Seamless Tank Top is the women's gym wardrobe go-to. Built from the same supportive, sweat-wicking fabric as the iconic Vital Leggings, this tank features a close-to-body fit, seamless construction, and Gymshark's signature physique-contouring texture. Removable bra padding offers optional support for low-impact workouts. Perfect worn alone or layered under a hoodie for warmup.

clothing.care_instructions: Machine wash cold. Do not tumble dry or iron. Do not use bleach or fabric softener.

fields.name: Nike Tech Fleece Joggers – Dark Grey Heather
fields.description: Nike Tech Fleece Joggers are the gold standard in performance lifestyle trousers. The ultra-premium Tech Fleece material is lightweight yet warm — perfect for pre-workout warmups, post-training recovery, or everyday wear. The slim tapered fit and precise cut create a modern silhouette that blends performance with streetwear. Ribbed cuffs and a stretch waistband with internal drawcord ensure a stay-put fit.

clothing.care_instructions: Machine wash cold. Tumble dry low. Do not iron directly on fabric. Do not dry clean.

fields.name: Adidas 3-Stripes 9-Inch Training Shorts – Black
fields.description: Adidas 3-Stripes 9-Inch Training Shorts are a versatile gym essential for all types of training. The 9-inch inseam provides excellent coverage for both gym and outdoor sessions. AEROREADY sweat-absorbing technology keeps you dry, and the 100% recycled polyester fabric is both sustainable and performance-ready. Side pockets provide storage for keys or cards. The iconic 3-Stripes make it instantly recognisable.

clothing.care_instructions: Machine wash at 40°C. Do not bleach. Tumble dry on low. Do not iron on print. Do not dry clean.

fields.name: Under Armour HeatGear Armour High-Rise Leggings – Black
fields.description: Under Armour HeatGear Armour High-Rise Leggings deliver lightweight, second-skin compression with superior moisture management for hot-weather training. The 4-way stretch construction moves freely in all directions, and the high-rise waistband provides core support and coverage during squats, lunges, and deadlifts. Anti-odor technology ensures freshness through the longest workouts.

clothing.care_instructions: Machine wash cold. Do not use fabric softener. Tumble dry low. Do not bleach or iron.

fields.name: Gymshark Crest T-Shirt – White
fields.description: The Gymshark Crest T-Shirt is a clean, minimal cotton-blend gym tee for those who prefer a classic, understated look. Featuring the embroidered Gymshark crest logo on the chest, it's a versatile piece that transitions seamlessly from gym to street. The soft, breathable fabric has a slight stretch for comfort, and the regular fit works for all body types. A gym wardrobe foundation piece.

clothing.care_instructions: Machine wash cold inside out. Tumble dry low. Wash with similar colours.

fields.name: Gymshark Everywear Comfort Joggers – Charcoal
fields.description: Gymshark Everywear Comfort Joggers are the ultimate lifestyle-meets-training jogger. Made from an ultra-soft fleece blend that rivals your favourite loungewear, they're designed for post-workout recovery, travel, and everyday comfort. The drawstring waist and ribbed cuffs provide a flattering, adjustable fit, while side and back pockets accommodate your essentials. Gymshark embroidery adds a subtle brand signature.

clothing.care_instructions: Machine wash cold. Do not tumble dry on high. Do not bleach or dry clean. Iron on low if needed.

fields.name: Nike Metcon 9 Training Shoes – Black/White
fields.description: The Nike Metcon 9 is the #1 training shoe in the world for a reason — it's built to handle everything the gym throws at you. The dual-density foam midsole is more flexible in the forefoot for cardio and stiffer in the heel for heavy lifting. The lightweight, breathable mesh upper with haptic print adds durability and texture. The full rubber outsole delivers reliable grip across all training surfaces. Rope wrap on the side enables confident rope climbs with minimal wear.

footwear.sole_material: Full rubber outsole with rope wrap for climbing
footwear.upper_material: Lightweight breathable mesh with haptic 3D-effect print overlay
footwear.usage: Cross-training, weightlifting, HIIT, rope climbs, box jumps, and gym sessions

fields.name: Adidas Ultraboost 5X Running Shoes – Core Black
fields.description: The Adidas Ultraboost 5X represents the pinnacle of everyday running shoe engineering. The new Boost+ midsole — featuring an updated compound for greater energy return — delivers a noticeably springier ride with every stride. The Primeknit upper wraps your foot in a precise, sock-like fit, while the Continental™ Rubber outsole provides exceptional all-surface grip. Reviewed and loved by elite runners and casual joggers alike.

footwear.sole_material: Boost+ midsole with Continental™ Rubber outsole
footwear.upper_material: Primeknit woven textile with supportive heel counter
footwear.usage: Road running, treadmill, long-distance training, and casual everyday wear

fields.name: Under Armour Project Rock BSR 4 Training Shoes – Team Royal
fields.description: Designed in collaboration with Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson, the UA Project Rock BSR 4 is built for the most demanding gym sessions. The new perforated mesh upper wraps and hugs the foot for superior security during multidirectional movements. Charged Cushioning® midsole absorbs impact and converts it to explosive energy. TriBase technology grounds your heel for maximum lifting stability. At $100, one of the best-value performance training shoes available.

footwear.sole_material: Rubber outsole with TriBase technology for heel grounding
footwear.upper_material: Perforated mesh textile for breathability and support
footwear.usage: Strength training, HIIT, cross-training, short runs, and athletic conditioning

fields.name: Nike Romaleos 4 Weightlifting Shoes – Black
fields.description: The Nike Romaleos 4 are the professional's choice for Olympic weightlifting and powerlifting. The elevated heel (19mm) shifts your centre of gravity forward for better squat depth and upright posture during clean and jerks. A solid, wide base provides a stable platform for maximum force transfer. Double-wrap metatarsal straps lock the foot down. Noticeably lighter than the Romaleos 3 without sacrificing the stability champions trust.

footwear.sole_material: Hard rubber outsole for maximum ground contact and stability
footwear.upper_material: Synthetic leather with dual-wrap metatarsal strap closure
footwear.usage: Olympic weightlifting, powerlifting (squats, cleans, snatches, jerks), competition lifting

fields.name: Nike Pegasus 41 Running Shoes – Wolf Grey
fields.description: The Nike Pegasus 41 is the latest iteration of the most trusted running shoe in Nike history — the world's #1 daily trainer. Powered by React X foam, it delivers 13% more energy return than its predecessor. The engineered mesh upper is breathable and supportive, and the redesigned outsole adds more rubber coverage for better durability. Whether you're training for a 5K or your first marathon, the Pegasus 41 handles it all.

footwear.sole_material: React X foam midsole with rubber outsole
footwear.upper_material: Engineered mesh with overlays for support
footwear.usage: Daily running, marathon training, road running, treadmill sessions

fields.name: Adidas Solarglide 6 Running Shoes – Signal Orange
fields.description: The Adidas Solarglide 6 is a high-mileage stability running shoe designed for overpronators and runners who need extra support. The Boost midsole provides superior energy return while the Solarglide stability frame manages inward rolling. The Primeknit upper creates a personalised fit that adapts to your foot shape. Continental™ Rubber outsole grips confidently in wet conditions. An ideal long-run companion.

footwear.sole_material: Boost midsole with Solarglide stability frame and Continental™ Rubber outsole
footwear.upper_material: Primeknit textile upper with supportive overlays
footwear.usage: Long-distance road running, daily training, overpronation support

fields.name: Adidas Adipower III Weightlifting Shoes – Black
fields.description: The Adidas Adipower III is a competition-grade weightlifting shoe trusted by elite Olympic lifters worldwide. Featuring a solid TPU heel with 21mm elevated heel-to-toe drop for optimal squat mechanics, a full-length TPU outsole for maximum energy transfer, and two metatarsal straps for lockdown security. Worn by World Championship and Olympic competitors. Built for athletes who train daily at the highest level.

footwear.sole_material: TPU midsole heel block (21mm) and full-length TPU outsole for rigidity
footwear.upper_material: Breathable mesh with synthetic leather overlays and dual metatarsal straps
footwear.usage: Olympic weightlifting, powerlifting, competition-level squatting and clean & jerk

fields.name: Under Armour TriBase Reign 5 Training Shoes – Grey
fields.description: The UA TriBase Reign 5 is Under Armour's most versatile multi-directional training shoe. The zero-drop TriBase outsole maximises ground contact during lifting while a flexible forefoot enables natural running mechanics. The lightweight, minimal design reduces weight penalty during metcons. UA Micro G foam cushioning protects during impact-intensive movements like box jumps and burpees. Perfect for CrossFit and functional fitness.

footwear.sole_material: Rubber outsole with TriBase technology for three-point ground contact
footwear.upper_material: Lightweight mesh with TPU overlays for lateral support
footwear.usage: Cross-training, CrossFit, HIIT, weightlifting, functional fitness

fields.name: Nike Free Metcon 6 Training Shoes – Dark Teal
fields.description: The Nike Free Metcon 6 bridges the gap between training shoe and running shoe. The Free forefoot allows natural foot flexibility during cardio and agility work, while the firm heel provides the stability needed for compound lifts. Ideal for athletes who do both cardio and weightlifting in the same session. The breathable mesh upper with durable overlays ensures long-term durability and comfort.

footwear.sole_material: Free-sole foam forefoot with firm rubber heel for stability
footwear.upper_material: Breathable mesh with overlays and extended rope-wrap side rubber
footwear.usage: Mixed training — cardio, weightlifting, HIIT, and moderate running

fields.name: Nike Vomero 17 Running Shoes – White/Platinum
fields.description: The Nike Vomero 17 is Nike's premium max-cushion daily trainer, designed for runners who want the most comfortable ride possible. The Air Zoom unit and plush React X foam stack deliver maximum impact protection for high-mileage runners. The engineered mesh upper is incredibly breathable, and the wider base provides a stable, confidence-inspiring platform for all foot types. A serious upgrade for long-distance daily training.

footwear.sole_material: React X foam with Air Zoom unit and rubber outsole
footwear.upper_material: Engineered mesh with supportive overlays and padded tongue
footwear.usage: Long-distance running, recovery runs, high-mileage daily training

fields.name: GNC Leather Gym Gloves – Black
fields.description: GNC Leather Gym Gloves are full-grain leather performance gloves designed for serious lifters. The palm padding absorbs bar pressure and reduces callus formation, while the neoprene back provides a breathable, flexible grip around the hand. Wrist wrap closure delivers up to 6 inches of wrist support during heavy compound lifts. Double stitching at all stress points ensures long-term durability even under daily use.

accessory.material: Full-grain genuine leather palm, neoprene back
accessory.usage: Weight training, pull-ups, barbell exercises, machine work
accessory.durability: Double stitching at stress points, reinforced palm padding for 12+ months of daily use

fields.name: MyProtein 600ml Metal Shaker – Matte Black
fields.description: The MyProtein Metal Shaker is a premium stainless steel bottle built for daily gym use. The 304-grade stainless steel interior prevents bacteria build-up, absorbs no odours, and is fully dishwasher-safe. The leak-proof lid with carabiner clip attaches easily to your gym bag, and the 600ml capacity is perfect for full post-workout shakes. The agitator sphere ensures smooth, lump-free mixing every time.

accessory.material: 304-grade stainless steel body, BPA-free plastic lid
accessory.usage: Mixing protein shakes, pre-workout, BCAAs, and powdered supplements
accessory.durability: Stainless steel construction — rust-resistant, odour-proof, and scratch-resistant. Estimated 5+ year lifespan.

fields.name: Amazon Basics Fabric Resistance Band Set – 3 Levels
fields.description: Amazon Basics Fabric Resistance Bands are a premium set of 3 non-slip fabric loop bands — Light, Medium, and Heavy resistance levels. Unlike latex bands that roll and slide, these fabric bands stay in place during squats, glute bridges, lateral walks, and clamshells. Ideal for glute activation, physiotherapy, and home workouts. The comfortable, skin-friendly fabric is soft, durable, and sweat-resistant.

accessory.material: 65% Cotton, 35% Polyester with non-slip inner rubber layer
accessory.usage: Glute activation, squats, lunges, lateral walks, clamshells, physiotherapy rehabilitation
accessory.durability: Reinforced stitching on all bands. Fabric construction avoids the rolling and snapping issues of latex bands. Rated for 10,000+ repetitions.

fields.name: GNC Pro Performance Neoprene Lifting Belt – Black
fields.description: The GNC Pro Performance Lifting Belt provides crucial lumbar and abdominal support during heavy compound movements including squats, deadlifts, overhead presses, and rows. Made from 6mm thick neoprene with a firm inner core, it supports intra-abdominal pressure throughout the lift. The Velcro closure allows micro-adjustment for a precise fit across all waist sizes, and the wide back panel distributes pressure evenly.

accessory.material: 6mm Neoprene outer shell with firm compressed foam core
accessory.usage: Squats, deadlifts, overhead press, barbell rows, and all heavy compound barbell work
accessory.durability: Heavy-duty Velcro closure with double-stitched edges. Suitable for daily training with proper care. Average lifespan 2–3 years of consistent use.

fields.name: GNC Pro Performance Wrist Wraps – Black/Red
fields.description: GNC Pro Performance Wrist Wraps deliver targeted wrist support during heavy pressing, overhead, and Olympic lifting movements. The 45cm wrap length provides medium-to-firm support without restricting blood flow, and the elastic thumb loop ensures a consistent wrap position every set. Made from a cotton-elastic blend for durability and comfort. Sold as a pair — suitable for both men and women.

accessory.usage: Bench press, overhead press, clean & jerk, snatch, gymnastics, and any exercise placing high stress on wrists
accessory.durability: Reinforced stitching along edges and around thumb loop. Machine-washable. Estimated 6–12 months with daily heavy use.

fields.name: MyProtein 5mm Neoprene Knee Sleeves – Black
fields.description: MyProtein 5mm Neoprene Knee Sleeves are an essential accessory for any serious squatter. The 5mm neoprene provides warmth and compression to maintain joint health during heavy squats, lunges, and leg presses. Compression improves proprioception, reduces the risk of patella tracking issues, and may aid recovery between sessions. Sold as a pair and available in multiple sizes from XS to XXL.

accessory.material: 5mm thick neoprene rubber — industry-standard lifting competition thickness
accessory.usage: Squats, leg press, lunges, and any knee-dominant exercise requiring joint support and warmth
accessory.durability: Neoprene maintains compression and elasticity for 1–2 years of daily use. Hand wash only to preserve neoprene properties.

fields.name: GNC Pro Performance 700ml Shaker Bottle – White
fields.description: GNC Pro Performance Shaker Bottle is a durable, BPA-free 700ml shaker with a leak-proof flip-top lid and a built-in wire whisk ball for smooth, clump-free mixing. Graduated measurements on the side make portion control easy, and the wide-mouth design allows easy cleaning and powder loading. Available in a clean white colourway with GNC branding. Dishwasher safe and gym-bag ready.

accessory.material: BPA-free food-grade HDPE plastic body with stainless steel whisk ball
accessory.usage: Mixing protein shakes, pre-workout, creatine, BCAAs, and other powdered drinks
accessory.durability: High-impact plastic resists cracking. Dishwasher safe on top rack. Wire whisk ball is stainless steel — rust-resistant. Estimated 1–2 year lifespan with regular use.

fields.name: MuscleBlaze Latex Resistance Loop Bands – Set of 5
fields.description: MuscleBlaze Latex Resistance Loop Bands offer a progressive 5-level resistance system from 2kg to 40kg in a single affordable kit. Made from 100% natural latex for superior elasticity, durability, and consistent resistance throughout the entire range of motion. Ideal for home workouts, physiotherapy, warm-up routines, glute training, and mobility work. Compact and portable — takes up virtually no storage space.

accessory.material: 100% natural latex — 0.35–1.5mm thickness depending on resistance level
accessory.usage: Warm-up, mobility training, glute activation, physiotherapy, pull-up assistance, home strength training
accessory.durability: Natural latex provides high elasticity. Avoid exposure to heat, oils, and sharp surfaces. Average lifespan 6–12 months with regular use depending on frequency and load.
included_items: 5 latex loop bands (Yellow: 2–5kg, Green: 5–12kg, Blue: 10–20kg, Black: 15–30kg, Red: 20–40kg)

fields.name: Gymshark Leather Powerlifting Belt – Black
fields.description: The Gymshark Leather Powerlifting Belt is a competition-grade 10mm thick, 4-inch wide genuine leather belt designed for maximal lifts. A single-prong roller buckle allows quick on/off during training while providing secure retention under load. The suede inner lining grips your training top to prevent shifting during heavy squats and deadlifts. Meets IPF legal specifications for thickness and width.

accessory.material: 10mm vegetable-tanned genuine leather with suede inner lining
accessory.usage: Powerlifting (squat, bench press, deadlift), Olympic weightlifting, competition use, and all maximal effort barbell training
accessory.durability: Full-grain leather construction rated for years of heavy training. Break-in period of 2–3 weeks. Clean with leather conditioner. Single-prong roller buckle is rated for 800kg+ tensile load.

fields.name: Under Armour Training Gloves – Black
fields.description: Under Armour Training Gloves combine lightweight construction with strategic grip pads on the palm and fingers for superior control of the bar. The breathable UA mesh back panel keeps hands dry and comfortable, and the wrap-around closure provides light wrist support. A Grippy silicone Hex pattern on the underside maximises grip on smooth or rubber surfaces. Ideal for everyday training from dumbbells to pull-ups.

accessory.material: Synthetic leather palm with Hex-pattern silicone, UA mesh back panel
accessory.usage: Barbell training, dumbbell exercises, pull-ups, lat pulldowns, cable exercises, and rowing movements
accessory.durability: Double-stitched at stress points. Synthetic leather palm maintains structure for 8–12 months of regular use. Machine washable.
